senses.gloss: shade of color, pattern (in weaving, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela).—Pl. עוֹנוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:1">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> [read:] <he>אלו לציבים ולע׳</he> (v. Ar. s. v. <cite ref="A02521"><he>אספריטין</he></cite>, where our w. reads: <he>ולעֵינוֹת</he>) these (the coarse threads) are used for tassels and for producing (raised) patterns; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:9">Yalk. Ps. 808</cite> <he>לצביתים ולעֵנוֹת</he>.
